title: Eleven Winters and One Chimney
subtitle: 乡间小屋 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 乡间小屋（生活与学习·居住与环境）
meta: 主题语境：乡间小屋（生活与学习·居住与环境）　|　核心词汇：cottage　|　正文 334 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cottage 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 my great-aunt ① rented a cottage that had stood empty eleven winters, and she said the renting was the whole of the arriving. The ② cottage, meaning the house and not the land, had one chimney and stayed that small; cottage, she said, is the only thing in a lane that is judged by how low the door is.

Every ③ cottage in that lane had the same low door, and the ④ cottage at the end, meaning the one she kept for the summers and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever painted twice. Cottage, my grandmother said, is nine parts door and one part somebody willing to bend; my great-aunt said the bending is the part that fills the summer.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the cottage was the whole of the industry, meaning the home work and not the house. The ⑥ cottage, meaning the home work and not any of that, is the only thing in a trade that everybody remembers and nobody regulates; cottage, he said, is either something you rent or the only word that means both a house and a home work. She said the home work is the part they remember.

By 1964 the ⑦ cottage had become a line in a valuation, and the valuation had become an argument about the door. The ⑧ cottage of the whole thing, my great-aunt wrote in June, was one chimney and thirty years of bending; cottage, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to bend. He said the bending was never mentioned.

The ⑨ cottage I remember is the one at the end, which she painted in 1970 and is still described as the smallest in the county. A ⑩ cottage, my grandmother said in 1972, is the only thing that improves by being lived in; every cottage, she said, is a home work that has agreed to look like a house. She said the home work was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 村舍（指那座房子本身，与那片土地相对）
C. 固定搭配：rent a cottage 租一间村舍
D. n. 村舍（指那条巷子里每一座）
E. n. 村舍（指末尾那一座）
F. n. 家庭作坊式产业（cottage industry 的用法）
G. n. 村舍（指估价单里提到的那一座）
H. n. 乡居；小屋生活（抽象总称）

items.q: rented a cottage that had stood empty eleven winters
The cottage, meaning the house and not the land
the cottage was the whole of the industry
The cottage, meaning the home work

answers.why: rent a cottage 意为“租一间村舍”，1956 年姑祖母租了一间空了十一个冬天的村舍。
cottage 意为“村舍”，指那座房子本身而不是那片土地，只有一个烟囱。
cottage 指那条巷子里每一座村舍，每一座都有同样低矮的门。
cottage 指末尾那一座（她留给夏天的那一座），是唯一有人粉刷过两次的。
cottage 意为“家庭作坊式产业”（cottage industry），父亲说家庭作坊就是那门行业的全部，指的是在家接活而不是那座房子。
cottage 为经济用语，指家庭作坊式生产而不是那座房子，是行业里人人都记得、却无人管理的东西。
cottage 意为“村舍”，指估价单里提到的那一座，到 1964 年这座村舍成了估价单里的一行。
cottage 意为“乡居、小屋生活”，姑祖母六月写道，整件事的乡居是一个烟囱三十年的弯腰进出。
cottage 意为“小屋、村舍”，我记得的是末尾那一座，她 1970 年粉刷过，至今仍被说成全县最小的。
cottage 为抽象总称，祖母说一间村舍是唯一会因为被住着而变好的东西。
